reviews.text: The serum made my skin sting within minutes and left red patches overnight.
The dropper barely picked up product, so I had to shake the bottle every time.
It felt sticky under moisturizer and pilled when I applied sunscreen.
The bottle arrived leaking and the label was already peeling off.
I used it for a month and saw no visible change in texture or dark spots.
The fragrance was strong enough to irritate my eyes.
